findings.title: Inconsistent string formatting style within the same module
findings.body: The new code on lines 5–6 switches from an f-string to `str.format_map`, while the rest of the module (line 4) uses f-strings. According to custom instructions in 'Naming Consistency' (A new identifier follows the casing already used in the same module): a new identifier follows the casing already used in the same module; here the formatting style is part of the module's style. Prefer the existing f-string style for consistency.

summary.problem: The change introduces an inconsistent string formatting style in the same module.
summary.done_well: The refactor improves maintainability by using a dictionary for interpolation, but the style should align with the existing f-string usage.
